```{r}
A <- matrix(c(1,1,1,1,
              2,3,1,5,
              -1,1,-5,3,
              3,1,7,-2), nrow = 4,byrow = TRUE)
(A)
b<- matrix(c(10,31,-2,18),nrow=4);(b)
```

```{r}
Ab <- cbind(A,b); (Ab)
```

Se realiza la eliminacion

```{r}
l21 <- Ab[2,1]/Ab[1,1];
l31 <- Ab[3,1]/Ab[1,1];
l41 <- Ab[4,1]/Ab[1,1];
A21 <- Ab[2,]-l21*Ab[1,1]; (A21)
A31 <- Ab[3,]-l31*Ab[1,1]; (A31)
A41 <- Ab[4,]-l31*Ab[1,1]; (A41)

```
